raised: Doesn't know what a 'קרן כספית יומית' is, whether it's safe, or how to get one
Unsure about the alternative because the 3.25% is only the site's assumption, not a promise
Can't judge the option of banks paying interest on up to 10,000 ₪ (4 of 8 banks, 3% at Discount)
Didn't understand the '123 מקור/מחושב/הזנתם' legend or the different underlines
The fee-plan jargon in 'מה זה' (basic/extended plan, צו, BANK-17/35 codes) is irrelevant and lost their interest
'מזומן שקלי' under 'במה אפשר להשקיע' meant nothing to them
Second calculator is confusing: an unexpected 500 ₪ a month, and 62,681 ₪ shown against 70,000 ₪ looked like a loss
BANK-xx/TXI-xx tags and 'מק"מ' were not understood
'כמה זה עולה' gives no actual number, only 'according to the price list'
Tax details (15%/25%, interest linked to the index, capital gains) meant nothing to them
Red exemption box alarmed them (looked like something was wrong) and they didn't understand it
'מה האתר לקח בחשבון' with lock icons and 'חסום' felt like the site's internal notes and wasn't understood
Didn't understand the y-axis note 'הציר האנכי לא מתחיל באפס'; the chart was less clear than the numbers
Not sure what 'בכסף של היום' means
Couldn't find whether their own bank pays interest on a current account
Wanted a simple rule for how much to keep in the current account
Couldn't find what their account actually costs per month in shekels
Worried by 'no deposit insurance', and nothing reassured them
Would drop the glossary and the 'מי מציע ומי מפקח' section

problems.why: The reader complains about what the second calculator shows (500 ₪ a month, the totals) but never mentions field widths, alignment or oversized inputs on a phone layout.
